description: D5 state-inspection — preset P3 (cycle:idea-to-design, window [1→5]). Each turn must emit the full ImaState object {active_stage, window, mode, forced_disciplines, next_handoff, decision_owner}. Proves the harness is 'context injection over state' (GOAL-3 §0), not blind chaining. All 6 fields required every turn per GOAL-3 §5 D5 and §10.1 (IMA core).

turns.text: State inspection turn 1: activate cycle:idea-to-design, enter idea-pmf. Report the full ImaState object: active_stage, window, mode, forced_disciplines, next_handoff, and decision_owner.
State inspection turn 2: advance to analysis-discovery. Report the updated full ImaState object with all 6 fields reflecting the new active stage and updated forced_disciplines.

State inspection turn 3: advance to design-ux (window stop). Report the final ImaState object and confirm next_handoff is END (or architecture if chaining were enabled) and decision_owner is correctly set for the current risk class.
